newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Casablanca port traffic up 13 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: Casablanca port traffic up 13 pct in first half.

text.p: Traffic in Morocco's main port, Casablanca, rose 13 percent in tonnage to 8,455,795 tonnes in the first half of this year compared with the same period last year, according to port statistics.

The Moroccan news agency MAP, quoting the latest port review, said export traffic rose 28 percent to over five million tonnes from 3.9 million, while imports fell three percent to 3.4 million tonnes from 3.5 million.
Container traffic through the port rose seven percent to total 989,565 tonnes compared with 920,692 in the first half of 1996.
A total of 1,682 ships called in the first six months of this year compared with 1,655 during the same period of 1996.
